title: refactor(pm): fleet-roster reads the mailbox constants from mailbox-open
body:
Fixes #25463

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

- `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` no longer declares `MAILBOX_LABEL`, `LEDGER_EXCLUSION` and `MAILBOX_BRANCH_PREFIX` itself. It imports them from `./mailbox-open.mjs`, their one owner since #25433 landed. Its own comment had asked for this ("once it lands, import them … and delete these").
- No caller imported the three from `fleet-roster.mjs`; `git grep` finds no import of that file. So nothing is re-exported.
- The self-test pins that the three values are the opener's own. The battery "wall notes, closing refs, verdicts and mailboxes" goes 12 → 13.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` → 69 cases in 7 batteries pass. `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` → 40 pass.
- `git grep -n "'pm:mailbox'" -- scripts/pm`: the one declaration is in `mailbox-open.mjs`. The other hits are test fixtures.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 30 derived families, all exit 0; `--ran` → 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Not governed: one file under `scripts/pm`. No changeset, because nothing is published (`skip-changeset`).
